design.purpose: pool the de-identification level effect across sessions 3/5/6; document batch-size wide null
design.convention: named minus anonymized (negative = anonymized scores sit above named)
design.inputs: archived score files; clustered SEs from results_s5/s6 cluster_t and the paper's session-3 clustered CI

headline_level_diff_correlations.note: Pearson correlation of per-headline anonymized-minus-named differences across sessions; same 341 headlines re-scored in each session

correlation_adjusted_conservative.note: empirical rho applied to full clustered SEs (conservative; only headline-level error is plausibly shared)

b1_vs_b25.note: EMT = minimum TOST margin; exceeds the +3.61 composition effect -> singleton contrast cannot certify level neutrality at the composition-effect scale

fictional_control_coincidence.note: the two clustered p-values are near-identical because the fictional level sits almost exactly midway: both contrasts share clustered |t| ~ 0.755
